gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.rationale: The presence of a KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation and the histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels support the diagnosis of Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) Mutation-associated Vascular Lesion.

rejected.label: Cherry Angioma
rejected.why: The lesion's characteristics, such as being a single, well-defined plaque, are not exclusive to Cherry Angioma and the lack of pain or pruritus does not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Telangiectasia
rejected.why: While the lesion is composed of telangiectasias, this feature alone is not sufficient to establish Telangiectasia as the primary diagnosis, especially given the presence of a specific somatic mutation.

rejected.label: Cutaneous Angiokeratoma
rejected.why: The clinical and histological features, while partially consistent with Cutaneous Angiokeratoma, do not provide strong evidence to prefer this diagnosis over Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) Mutation-associated Vascular Lesion.
